answer: Time-locked vesting: every agent's rewards vest over 30 epochs and stay frozen until the key keeps passing peer-graded answers. The attacker pays up front: each fake identity must do honest work for weeks before any payout, so that cost grows linearly with every sybil vertex added. Failure case: if a gale of fakes is caught mid-vesting, their unvested pool is burned, and no key can harbor stolen value during the lock.
